Check before buying

  • Match your machine type and processor platform.
  • Confirm the amount of soldered memory fitted to your unit.
  • Match the drive interface, length and mounting hardware.
  • Check shared positions and configuration exclusions.
  • Use Lenovo’s documentation for your exact unit.
